verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Postmark serves an llms.txt at postmarkapp.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The file is agent-oriented: it indexes the API endpoints and includes task-first TypeScript examples, webhook validation patterns, a test-token tip and a repair guide, and Postmark also publishes a pricing.txt. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the docs pages (developer.md returns 404) and no independent corroboration of agents actually using the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Install, shared client, template send, batch handling, webhook payload validation, and repair guide — complete TypeScript path from setup to production
Task-first TypeScript examples for receipts, welcome emails, and other structured transactional sends using `TemplateAlias` and `TemplateModel`
For testing without actually sending emails, use `POSTMARK_API_TEST` as your token.
